run_compliment_cli: run the compliment cli to snap camera photos and generate compliments for detected objects
create_ae_instance: create an actionengine instance with a websocket stream connected to actionengine.dev
find_objects_in_image: find objects in a camera frame image using the actionengine find_objects_in_image action
make_compliment: generate a compliment for a detected object in an image using the make_compliment action
review_sync_main: review the sync_main function that configures actionengine global settings and runs the async main loop
